svg.title: VeriFine framework: Figure 2 from the paper
svg.desc: Three panels compare policy improvement, previous fixed-curriculum and static-judge methods, and judge improvement. Below, Policy sends self-generated rollouts to a reference-free Judge, which returns rewards and an adaptive curriculum. The Judge selects informative failure cases for targeted human feedback and improves through coactive calibration. The five steps below highlight the corresponding parts of this original figure.
